blogPosts.title: Best Ways to Prevent Blocked Drains in Ashburton Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn effective tips to keep your drains clear and avoid blockages in Ashburton's unique plumbing conditions with local advice.
body: Blocked drains are a common issue in Ashburton homes due to factors like tree roots, grease buildup, and ageing pipes. To prevent this, avoid planting large trees near drains and schedule regular inspections. Kitchen sinks are often blocked by grease and food waste. In Ashburton, where many homes have older plumbing, this can lead to slow drainage. Always scrape plates before washing and use drain strainers to catch debris. Pouring boiling water down the drain weekly can dissolve grease, but avoid chemical cleaners as they can damage pipes. For Ashburton residents, we recommend professional drain cleaning every 1-2 years to maintain flow.

Bathroom drains clog from hair, soap scum, and minerals. Ashburton's hard water can accelerate scale buildup, so regular cleaning is essential. If you notice slow drainage, contact a plumber promptly to avoid backups, especially in Ashburton's humid summers when bacteria growth increases.

Outdoor drains and stormwater systems in Ashburton are susceptible to leaf litter and debris, especially in autumn. Keep gutters and downpipes clear, and ensure garden beds are not directing soil into drains. Ashburton properties with driveways should avoid washing oils or chemicals into drains, as they can cause blockages and environmental harm. Regular gutter cleaning, which we offer for $80-$120, can prevent outdoor drain issues.

In Ashburton, sewer line blockages can cause major health hazards if not addressed quickly. Signs include gurgling sounds, foul odours, and multiple fixture backups. Avoid flushing wipes, sanitary products, or excessive toilet paper, as these are common culprits. For Ashburton homes, we recommend a yearly sewer line check to identify potential problems early.
